overview: The Lightcrawler Pits are the nocturnal heart of the Tenebrous Mountains, glowing with holy resonance and swarming with bioluminescent predators.
history: The Pits formed from ancient Luclin holy caverns.
Lightcrawlers evolved bioluminescent organs to navigate the darkness.
Akhevan ritualists attempted to corrupt the holy resonance but failed.
Vampyric raiders use the tunnels to ambush weakened prey.
hooks: A holy flare mutates a Lightcrawler brood.
Akhevan scouts attempt a shadow breach into the Pits.
Vampyric raiders steal Lightcrawler eggs for rituals.
A new holy cavern opens after a resonance collapse.
